headlines.title: It’s the Best Time to Get a Flu Shot. The CDC Tool to Find Vaccines Near You Doesn’t Work
headlines.description: The CDC’s vaccine search tool, vaccines.gov, helps people find out where to get vaccinated nearby. The problem? It doesn’t work. Here’s what to use instead.

headlines.title: Here’s How Many Whole Grains To Eat in a Day To Boost Heart Health
headlines.description: Whole grains are linked to better heart health, and a study found four-to-six daily servings lower the risk of heart disease. How to boost whole grain intake.

headlines.title: Amanda Peet Opens up About Breast Cancer Journey on TODAY
headlines.description: Actor and breast cancer survivor Amanda Peet sits down with TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie to share an update on her inspiring journey and open up about navigating the loss of both of her parents. Peet also reflects on her cancer diagnosis, talks about how she stayed in good spirits during treatment and shares words of encouragement for others facing cancer.

headlines.title: Wearable tech that could help treat depression to be available by prescription
headlines.description: An at-home wearable device that was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to help treat depression will be available by prescription. NBC News' Gadi Schwartz talks to Dr. Akshay Syal about how the tech works.

headlines.title: New Progress Update on Cancer Vaccine Research
headlines.description: Vaccines are one of the fastest growing areas in cancer research, and one industry research firm projects that the market for personalized cancer vaccines could reach more than $8 billion a year by 2034. Former NBC News correspondent Kristen Dahlgren and cancer researcher Dr. Karen Knudsen, CEO of The Parker Institute, join TODAY to share the latest updates on where cancer vaccines stand and what it means for treatment in the future.

headlines.title: New Weight Loss Drug Shows Promising Results Over GLP-1s
headlines.description: New trial data for the weight loss drug called retatrutide shows it helped people living with obesity and type 2 diabetes lose up to 50lbs or 21% of their body weight. Those without diabetes lost up to 70lbs, 25% of body weight, making it the most weight loss ever recorded in a drug trial for diabetes patients. NBC medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar joins TODAY to break down how the drug compares to GLP-1s.

headlines.title: The best candle warmers for all the home fragrance without the flame
headlines.description: We spoke with experts about how to use a candle warmer as a safer alternative to an open flame. Shop candle warmer lamps with auto shut-off and dimmable features.
